Definition: Nearjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Neariah = "servant of Jehovah"; 1) one of the 6 sons of Shemaiah in the line of the royal family of David of the tribe of Judah in the time after the captivity; 2) son of Ishi and one of the captains of the 500 Simeonites who, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah, drove out the Amalekites from Mount Seir
